title: get
summary: Многозначный глагол **get**: получить/купить/найти, стать (get tired), добраться (get to), а также get in/out/on/off/up.
ru:
## get + существительное: получить, купить, принести, найти
**Get** очень частый глагол. Его значение зависит от контекста.
> Did you **get** my message? — Yes, I got it yesterday. — Ты получил моё сообщение? (получить)
> I like your jacket. Where did you **get** it? — Где ты её купила? (купить)
> Wait here. I'll **get** the doctor. — Подожди тут. Я позову врача. (привести/принести)
> It's hard to **get** a job now. — Сейчас трудно найти работу. (найти)
> I **got** the bus to work. — Я поехал на работу на автобусе. (сесть на автобус)

## get + прилагательное: становиться
**Get + прилагательное** = «становиться, делаться».
> If you don't eat, you **get hungry**. — Если не есть, проголодаешься.
> Drink your tea. It's **getting cold**. — Пей чай, он остывает.
> I hope she **gets better** soon. — Надеюсь, ей скоро станет лучше.
> We **got wet** in the rain. — Мы промокли под дождём.
Устойчивые: **get married** (пожениться), **get dressed** (одеться), **get lost** (заблудиться), **get tired** (устать).

## get to + место: добраться
> I usually **get to** work at 8.30. — Обычно я прихожу на работу в 8:30.
> We **got to** Manchester at 12.45. — Мы добрались до Манчестера в 12:45.
> How did you **get here**? — Как ты сюда добрался?
> What time did you **get home**? — Во сколько ты пришёл домой? (**get home** — без to)

## get in / out / on / off / up
- **get in / get out of** — машина, такси: She **got in** the car. A man **got out of** the car.
- **get on / get off** — автобус, поезд, самолёт: We **got on** the bus and **got off** at the station.
- **get up** — вставать с постели: I **get up** at seven.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I got to home at six.~~ → I **got home** at six.
- ~~She got in the bus.~~ → She **got on** the bus.
- ~~We arrived to the hotel.~~ → We **got to** the hotel (или arrived **at**).
en:
## get + noun: receive, buy, bring, find
The meaning of **get** depends on the context.
> Did you **get** my message? — Yes, I got it yesterday. (= receive)
> I like your jacket. Where did you **get** it? (= buy)
> Wait here. I'll **get** the doctor. (= fetch)
> It's hard to **get** a job now. (= find)
> I **got** the bus to work. (= take)

## get + adjective: become
> If you don't eat, you **get hungry**.
> Drink your tea. It's **getting cold**.
> I hope she **gets better** soon.
> We **got wet** in the rain.
Also: **get married, get dressed, get lost, get tired**.

## get to + place: arrive
> I usually **get to** work at 8.30.
> We **got to** Manchester at 12.45.
> How did you **get here**?
> What time did you **get home**? (**get home** — no to)

## get in / out / on / off / up
- **get in / get out of** a car or taxi: She **got in** the car. A man **got out of** the car.
- **get on / get off** a bus, train or plane: We **got on** the bus and **got off** at the station.
- **get up** — leave your bed: I **get up** at seven.

## Common mistakes
- ~~I got to home at six.~~ → I **got home** at six.
- ~~She got in the bus.~~ → She **got on** the bus.
structure:
## Значения get
| Значение | Конструкция | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| получить | get + сущ. | I got a letter. |
| купить | get + сущ. | Where did you get it? |
| найти | get + a job | He got a job. |
| принести, позвать | get + сущ. | I'll get a glass of water. |
| стать | get + прилагательное | It gets dark early. |
| добраться | get to + место | We got to the hotel. |
| добраться | get here / there / home | I got home late. |

## Предлоги
| В чём | Прибыть | Выйти |
|---|---|---|
| car / taxi | get in / get into | get out of |
| bus / train / plane | get on | get off |

## Формы get
| get | got | got |
|---|---|---|
| Present | Past | Past participle |

## Памятка
> **get** + прилагательное = становиться · **get to** = добраться · **get home / here / there** — без to.

exercises.title: get + прилагательное
exercises.instruction: Вставьте нужное слово: **hungry, cold, dark, tired, better, wet, lost, dressed**.

items.text: I'm walking all day. I'm getting {{tired}}.
We forgot our umbrellas and got {{wet}}.
I hope your cold gets {{better}} soon.
We got {{lost}} in the forest because we had no map.

exercises.title: get in, out, on, off, to

items.text: She got {{in}} the taxi and went home.
We got {{on}} the train at Bishkek station.
We got {{off}} the bus in front of the museum.
A man got {{out}} of the car.
What time did you get {{to}} the hotel?
I got {{on}} the plane and sat by the window.

items.q: I got a postcard from my friend.
It's getting late. Let's go home.
Where did you get that bag?
We got to the cinema at six.
I'll get a coffee. Do you want one?
What time did you get ___ yesterday?
We got ___ the bus at the station.
He got ___ the car and started the engine.
items.why: car — get in / get out of.

items.q: I usually ___ up at seven o'clock.

items.why: difficult + to + глагол: to get a job.

items.prompt: Мы приехали в Лондон в семь часов.
answers: We got to London at seven.
We arrived in London at seven.

items.prompt: Во сколько ты пришёл домой вчера?
answers: What time did you get home yesterday?

items.prompt: Я вышла из автобуса на этой остановке.
answers: I got off the bus at this stop.
I got off the bus at that stop.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями. Проверьте по образцу.

items.prompt: What time do you get up?
items.sample: I get up at seven o'clock.

items.prompt: How do you get to work or school?

items.prompt: What time do you get home?
items.sample: I get home at about six.
I get tired in the evening.

items.prompt: Where did you get your phone?
